name: terragrunt-18410a16-blind29-ots
instr:
# Terragrunt behaving wrongly in many places, diagnosed without a test suite

The repository has received 29 separate undocumented edits, and the misbehaviour they cause shows up all over ordinary use.

This tool drives infrastructure work across many small units, and ordinary use of it now goes wrong in a great many unrelated places. Nothing about the files people hand it changed and nothing about what they type changed, yet the same sessions that used to behave correctly now behave incorrectly, and in several places something that used to succeed now fails outright.

Working the full-screen keyboard interface no longer lands where it should. The key that jumps to the last item and the key that jumps back to the first both miss, End and Home miss in the same way, and paging forward or backward never stops at either end of the list. Typing a prefix that fits two of four items makes the footer claim three, and after committing that search the key that walks to the next hit steps over one rather than onto it, so walking the hits visits the wrong items and wraps onto the wrong one.

Reading an item on that same screen is wrong as well. The pane describing a plain unit labels it with the wrong word for what it is, even though where it comes from, what it depends on, what depends on it and its reading lines are all present.
